description: Moves an annotation's text to at (sheet mm; IAnnotation.SetPosition2), or gives a note new text. A centre mark sits on its circle's centre and cannot be moved: at on one is invalid_argument, nothing asked of SOLIDWORKS (INote.SetText; $PRP:"…" links allowed). Each value is recorded before and put back on failure. Checked: the position reads back within 0.01 mm and the text as written; the model is unchanged. text is for notes only: a model dimension's value is changed with dimension.set on the model, never from the drawing. Waits, changing nothing (busy, user_editing), while the user edits a view's sketch or the sheet format (sheet_format: true) or has a command open. After the user exits a view's sketch, SOLIDWORKS keeps that view activated and changes keep waiting until the user lets go of it: ask them to double-click the sheet outside every view.

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

annotation.description: The annotation: a reference (r1.annotation.…), or its name (with @view when names repeat).

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

at.description: Where its text goes, sheet mm.
